method: parent/child timing tree derived from CODE field definitions (vulkan_encoder.py _submit_resident :790-846; ane_resident.py submit :161-227 with explicit doc comments), then measured on existing battery reports (out-meas-1/5/10). Non-overlapping critical path reported. Main directive: tree before zero-copy architecture; smallest measured copy-removal first; no speculative overlap.

field_definitions_from_code.marshal_ns: host input serialization: mx.eval + ascontiguous + tobytes per round (parent, sibling)
field_definitions_from_code.elapsed_ns: wraps session.submit(): write_ns (request+inline payloads to worker stdin) + child round; SIBLING of marshal
field_definitions_from_code.child elapsed_ms: worker-internal: recv + stage + exec + read + send-back
field_definitions_from_code.read_ns: DEFINED AS elapsed_ns - write_ns (residual incl. worker compute wait)
field_definitions_from_code.back_ns: host output conversion frombuffer + mx.array (parent, sibling)
field_definitions_from_code.ane.exec_ms: SUM OF SESSION-ROUND WALL (exec_ns += elapsed), NOT device execution — v1 mislabeled this

segments.segment: session round (write 317.3 + worker round 978.0 + parent-side IPC/handoff ~736.7 = ane.exec_ms)

non_overlapping_critical_path_ms.stability: meas-5 and meas-10 within ~1.5% per segment (marshal 2117.6/2087.0, round 1674.5/1663.1, residual 2291.2/2245.7)

worker_internal_bound: pure ANE device exec is NOT directly recorded; it nests inside worker elapsed_ms 978.0 ms, bounded above by ~430 ms after removing stage_ms 230.0 + save_ms 315.0 (recv/read/send shares unrecorded) => device exec <= ~8% of stage; ANE compute is not the encoder-stage bottleneck

io_volume_per_pass.note: payloads travel inline on worker stdin/stdout (file round trip already removed per ane_resident.py docstring); remaining copies are host-side tobytes/frombuffer + pipe

smallest_measured_copy_removal_candidate: marshal tobytes per round: preallocate/reuse contiguous buffers or zero-copy export (preserves ownership: parent keeps mx arrays alive through round; lifetime: buffer consumed before next round mutates inputs; hash checks: output sha pins unchanged)
save_ms output retrieval share (315 ms sum): stream outputs once instead of retrieve+save
both require one measured A/B each with golden 104/104 + mel/hidden/transcript hash gates per run
explicitly_not_claimed: no zero-copy architecture proposal before this tree
no speculative overlap of GPU feeder (exact flow still being mapped)
static marker/K derivation supports the existing exact contract; it is not proof all numerical paths are native-identical
